text.description_html:
Acorn IHKBP, 36-3/4 Inch Heart Strap Door Hinges For Rated for 600 LBS

This Heavy Duty Heart Tip Hinge is ideal for garages, barns and gates. It not only adds an authentic finishing touch but is truly functional as well. Featuring a heart tip, this 36-3/4 inch long strap hinge is hand forged using traditional hammer and anvil techniques. Zinc and acrylic powder coated, it have a lifetime no-rust warranty. This strap hinge is rated at 600 pounds per pair and have been tested to 1,000 pounds without failure. The 30 Inch Heavy Door Heart Tip Strap Hinges is supplied with 1/4 inch by 3 inch stainless steel square head lags.

Also Available 30-3/4 Inch Heart Strap Door Hinge

Specifications of the Heart Tip Iron Art Hinge:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Length: 36-3/4"
  • Strap Width at hinge: 3"
  • Length of Pad 6"
  • Width of Pad: 3-3/4"
  • Rated at 600 pounds per pair.
  • Zinc and acrylic powder coated for long lasting life.
  • Packaged with black finish mounting wood screws and a 1/4 x 3" stainless steel square head lag.
  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty

Sold Individually
